verdict.summary: Composio has no managed Shopify app, so you must create your own. Custom distribution to your own or development stores needs no listing; public use means App Store review, whose timeline wasn't confirmed.
verdict.hands_on_effort: 1-2 hours for custom setup; days for an App Store submission
verdict.time_to_first_connection: About 30-60 min (unverified; Dev Dashboard steps not captured)
verdict.approval_wait: None for custom distribution; App Store review timeline not confirmed

gates.name: Custom app / development store
gates.unlocks: Connect your own store through your app's OAuth flow.
limits: Custom distribution covers a single store, stores in one Plus organization, or development stores.

gates.name: Custom distribution to additional eligible stores
gates.unlocks: Use the app on other stores within the custom-distribution reach (same Plus organization or development stores).
limits: No install or user cap found in captured pages.
Apps accessing customer personal data must meet protected customer data requirements (data minimization, transparency, security).

gates.name: Public distribution (Shopify App Store)
limits: Listing page required even with limited visibility; same app requirements apply.
Cannot submit apps using APIs deprecated within 90 days.

steps.title: Decide distribution type
steps.detail: Use custom distribution for one merchant, one Plus organization, or development stores. Use public distribution only if you need many merchants.

steps.title: Create a development store
steps.detail: Create a dev store you own to test against. It also serves as the demo store for a later listing.
gotchas: Account type needed for creating dev stores was not verified.

steps.title: Create the app in Shopify
steps.detail: Create an app in the Shopify Dev Dashboard and note the client ID and secret. Exact menu steps were not verified.
gotchas: The dev-dashboard configuration URL tried in research returned 404.

steps.title: Choose minimal scopes
steps.detail: List only the read/write access scopes you need. Composio's default list is long (about 40 scopes), so trim it.

steps.title: Set the redirect URI
steps.detail: Create a custom OAuth2 auth config in Composio, then paste its callback URL into your Shopify app's allowed redirection URLs.

values.label: Redirect URI
values.value: Composio callback URL (see the Composio callout on this page)

gotchas: Composio's default redirect and a probed callback differed; use the one shown in your auth config.

steps.title: Configure Composio auth config
steps.detail: Enter client ID, secret, and scopes. Authorization URL is https://{subdomain}.myshopify.com/admin/oauth/authorize and token URL is https://{subdomain}.myshopify.com/admin/oauth/access_token.

steps.title: Connect your dev store
steps.detail: Run the authorization flow against your store's myshopify.com subdomain and approve the scopes.

steps.title: Check protected customer data and restricted scopes
steps.detail: If you need customer personal data or approval-gated scopes, review the protected customer data requirements and request approval.

steps.title: Prepare listing materials
steps.detail: Draft a privacy policy, listing copy and pricing (free trial recommended, 14 days). Ensure a current API version and a demo dev store link.

steps.title: Submit for App Store review
steps.detail: Submit the app against Shopify's App Store requirements; limited visibility still needs a listing.

steps.title: Wait for review
steps.detail: Shopify reviews against its app requirements. Timeline was not captured.

requirements.detail: Apps using APIs deprecated within 90 days can't be submitted.
Listing needs a dev store showing the app.
Free trial recommended (14 days); label free plan clearly.
Needed if accessing customer personal data.

scopes.effect: Customer personal data triggers protected customer data requirements.
Standard access scopes; tiering not verified.

blockers.cause: Composio's callback differs from the URL registered in Shopify.
blockers.fix: Copy the callback URL from your Composio auth config into the Shopify app's allowed redirection URLs.

blockers.cause: App uses APIs deprecated within 90 days.
blockers.fix: Upgrade to a current API version.

composio.note: No managed OAuth app exists for Shopify, so you need your own app from the start and register its credentials as a custom OAUTH2 auth config in Composio. Trim the long default scope list.

evidence.claim: Composio has no managed OAuth for Shopify; custom OAUTH2 config with URL templates and long default scopes.
Customer data access is gated by protected customer data requirements.
evidence.quote: Find out if your app needs to meet the protected customer data requirements
